start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher hoon. Aaj hum plants ko herbs, shrubs aur trees mein group karenge. Aapka din kaisa raha?

turns.reply: Kabir, sawaal tough lag raha hai toh use chhote steps mein karte hain—pehle bas batayiye, kaunsa part pareshaan kar raha hai?
Theek hai Kabir, aap continue karenge, chhota break lenge, ya aaj ke liye stop karenge? Aap jo choose karna chahein, batayiye.
Kabir, shrubs ke stems hard woody hote hain, isliye ve herbs se bade dikhte hain. Screen par shrubs wale stems ka label dhoondhiye.
Kabir, yeh part sach mein uljhan wala hai; chaliye sirf ek baat dekhiye: hard woody stem lakdi jaisa hota hai. Aap ek example dijiye.

turns.board: Is a hibiscus (gudhal) plant a herb, a shrub or a tree?
turns.reply: Kabir, aise naam lesson ka hissa nahi hain. Hibiscus ka stem hard woody hota hai; ab branches ground ke paas shuru hoti hain ya upar?
Kabir, aapki baat se lag raha hai ki aap pareshaan hain. Kya aap abhi theek hain?
